July 2026 section (all previously reported):
- Copilot Studio AUTOMATICALLY creates a Microsoft Entra Agent ID for EVERY new agent, and you can
  NO LONGER OPT OUT at the environment level.
- (Preview) Add a WORKFLOW or an MCP SERVER as a tool for agents on the GitHub Copilot harness.
- (Preview) Submit your MCP server for MICROSOFT CERTIFICATION.
- Real-time agents across voice AND digital messaging; GPT-5-Chat (Preview) model; Application
  Insights monitoring for real-time agents.
- (Preview) Export ENVIRONMENT-LEVEL AGENT TELEMETRY to Azure Application Insights via PPAC.
- (Preview) Users attach files to a conversation and view files the agent CREATES.
